name: btp-genai-orchestration-demo
description: Dual-mode RAG/grounding demo on SAP BTP Generative AI Hub orchestration — the SOUVERÄN-KI pattern re-implemented on SAP. MOCK (offline) + LIVE (gen_ai_hub) behind one LLMBackend protocol.

paragraphs: I built SOUVERÄN-KI — a self-hosted, open-source enterprise RAG platform (Python, FastAPI, Ollama, Qdrant, LangGraph, Keycloak; 43 tests, green CI). This repo demonstrates the same retrieval-augmented generation / grounding pattern re-implemented on SAP BTP, using the Generative AI Hub orchestration service instead of a self-hosted stack. It is a focused, recruiter-readable proof that the grounding architecture I run on-prem maps cleanly onto SAP's managed GenAI offering.

The demo answers IT-operations questions from a set of "runbook" Markdown documents, grounding each answer in retrieved source sections and citing exactly which chunks it used. It runs in two modes behind a single abstraction — fully offline (MOCK, the default) or against the real SAP orchestration service (LIVE).
